ns2:section.sectionText: Title: Integral Equations and Fast Methods Topic: This course discusses the use of integral equations as a computational tool to solve partial differential equations (PDEs). Topics covered include: Elements of Potential Theory. Integral equations for the Laplace, Poisson, Helmholtz PDEs, applications. Discretizations of integral equations and singular quadrature. Fast algorithms, including the Fast Multipole Method and, time permitting, more recent fast linear-algebraic approaches. http://bit.ly/inteq13
